wiki.title: T. J. Roberts (politician)
wiki.extract: Theodore Joseph "T.J." Roberts (born February 23, 1998) is an American politician and constitutional attorney serving as a member of the Kentucky House of Representatives for the 66th district. A member of the Republican Party, he assumed office on January 1, 2025.
